title: Two-path choice
summary: Compare two options with trade-offs and pick with reasons.
objectives: List one upside and one downside for each option
Choose with at least one clear reason
briefMarkdown:
## Mission

You have 90 minutes after school.

**Option A:** Finish a science project due tomorrow.
**Option B:** Help a sibling with homework, then start your project later tonight.

Map trade-offs, then choose.

quiz.prompt: Which statement is a trade-off analysis (not a pure feeling)?

options.label: A is boring so B wins
A lowers risk of a late project; B helps family now but shortens my work time
I always pick whatever friends do

quiz.teachBack: Trade-offs name what you gain and what you give up.

reflectionPrompt: Which option would you pick today, and what is your main reason?
successCriteria: States a choice with a reason

steady.coachNote: Ask what they would check tomorrow morning.

fast.coachNote: Add a third option they invent and compare.

llm.tutorBrief: Help weigh trade-offs. Do not moralise family vs school. Stay practical.
